description: The bar chart illustrates the percentage point difference in performance between two models across various configurations, with the x-axis displaying different model settings such as "hidden:[]", "hidden:[100]", and "hidden:[50, 50]". The y-axis represents the "% point difference", ranging from -0.1 to 0.2. Each bar corresponds to a specific configuration, with the bars colored in shades of blue, indicating the difference in performance. The chart shows that the "hidden:[]", "linear" configuration has a negative difference, while the "hidden:[100]", "ReLU" configuration has a positive difference, suggesting a variation in performance across the different settings. The bars are arranged in a way that allows for a clear comparison of the performance differences between the configurations.
